potd.title: Fog over the Blue Ridge
potd.caption: Fog over the Blue Ridge, at dawn. Shot from Craggy Gardens as first light burned off the valley mist.

news_photo.title: Relief convoys move at first light
news_photo.caption: Relief convoys move at first light. Ties to today's Daily Brief lead on the reopened corridor.
